payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP recurrence f(n)=2*f(n-1)+d(n)-d(n-1) mod M, where d(n) is number of divisors of n. Base cases f(1)=1, f(2)=3, f(3)=6.
payload.rationale: The problem asks for number of good pairings, a combinatorial counting problem. Solution uses a 1D DP array where f(n) depends on f(n-1) and divisor function, fitting dp_counting_combinatorics perfectly.
